GM workers vote on tentative labor agreements

Unifor and General Motors reached tentative labor agreements for over 4,600 unionized autoworkers in Ontario. The voting process for these agreements was scheduled to conclude on Sunday. The details of the tentative contracts were agreed upon by both parties on August 22.
